spectral_shift: a raw Laplace atom exp(-t lambda) is sent to exp(-t(lambda+1/4)); the endpoint atom lambda=-1/4 is sent to zero
weak_localizer: the 1-y normalized localizer makes the endpoint constant and contributes zero, but permits a spurious rate-zero atom
sharp_support: the RH-equivalent shifted rates are at least 1/4, so y is at most q=exp(-h/4) and the required localizer is q M_F(t)-M_F(t+h)
consequence: the sharp normalized localizer is a positive diagonal congruence of the raw localizer and retains the endpoint negative rank-one Schur gate
positivity_invariance: translation of a signed spectral measure preserves its coefficient signs; normalization moves support but does not manufacture positivity
acceptance_test: Recompute the completed endpoint-gamma-prime localizer in the normalized chart, verify the source RH criterion under the +1/4 spectral shift, and certify the normalized gamma-prime cone with interval tails or a source factor.
